test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) PT-XR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a18c8472e88fbb94ce4b868614087175b2e2557882865ac42f8022fc409a5f31.png] 

Option 2) EI-MH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eff1d73f08f6190ed1bb98db46534d4ca629287c3e2e66d586b7a43d00941f5.png] 

Option 3) NR-VQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f81df992f86f0690e736ee1b45bb1021f79cacd3e42b6bc16144ddf2d13df389.png] 

Option 4) GK-OJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b386256335b2c8e0c4677cf36ba644dc457a0ed175e4ec738dc419cc4c31b7a5.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'PT-XR' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
